keyword: how to choose an electric concrete pump

title.en: How to Choose an Electric Concrete Pump from the Pinjin Catalogue
title.zh: 如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists electric trailer pumps on one hub. Match the printed motor kilowatts, output, pressure and distance, then inquire. No list price is printed.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动拖泵放在同一分类页。先对照已印电机千瓦、输送量、压力和距离，再询盘。目录不印标价。

h1.en: Choose an Electric Concrete Pump from the Xingtai Electric Hub
h1.zh: 从邢台电动分类页选一台电动混凝土泵

directAnswer.en: To choose an electric concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, open the electric hub and read one model page at a time. Match the printed motor kilowatts to the supply the site can hold, then the output, outlet pressure and the distance pair on that same page. Compact rows such as Electric 15 are not substitutes for Electric 60 or Electric 80. The catalogue prints no list price, no production-day count and no export-country list. Send the model address to the contact page for a quote.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购电动混凝土泵时，先打开电动分类页，一次只读一台型号页。把该页印出的电机千瓦对照现场能稳住的供电，再看同一页的输送量、出口压力和距离。电动15这类紧凑行不能代替电动60或电动80。目录不印标价、不印生产天数、不印出口国名单。把型号地址发到询盘页再要报价。

heading.en: Which electric pages sit on the hub?
heading.zh: 电动分类页上有哪些型号？

body.en: The electric hub published by Hebei Pinjin Machinery names the compact B500S-83D, Electric 10 and Electric 15, then Electric 20, Electric 30, Electric Low Pressure 40, Electric 40, Electric 50, Electric Low Pressure 60, Electric 60, Electric 80, HBT80-16 and HBT8018. Open [/en/products/electric-concrete-pumps/](/en/products/electric-concrete-pumps/) and then the single model. A diesel engine code does not belong on this order.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械的电动分类页列出紧凑型 B500S-83D、电动10、电动15，以及电动20、电动30、电动低压40、电动40、电动50、电动低压60、电动60、电动80、HBT80-16 和 HBT8018。先打开 [/zh/products/electric-concrete-pumps/](/zh/products/electric-concrete-pumps/)，再进入单一型号。柴油机型号不要写进这张订单。

body.en: On an electric sheet the buying cells are motor power, theoretical or stated output, outlet pressure where it is printed, hopper where it is printed, and the distance labels on that page. Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa and 120 m / 40 m. Electric 80 prints 110 kW, 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m. Do not paste the second pair onto the first page.
body.zh: 电动页上要看的采购格子是电机功率、理论或标明的输送量、印了才算的出口压力、印了才算的料斗，以及该页自己的距离标题。电动20印 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、120 m / 40 m。电动80印 110 kW、60 m³/h、900 m / 300 m。不要把后一组抄到前一页。

heading.en: What goes to Xingtai with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 询盘发给邢台时带什么？

body.en: Send the product path, maximum aggregate, the output you need, horizontal metres, vertical metres, site voltage and frequency, country and purchase timing. Most electric sheets do not print a voltage cell. B500S-83D is one page that does print 380 V. Ask for the price on [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a numeric price on these pages.
body.zh: 请发送产品路径、最大骨料、需要的输送量、水平米数、垂直米数、现场电压和频率、国家与采购时间。多数电动页没有电压格子。B500S-83D 是印了 380 V 的一页。价格请在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 询问。河北品锦机械不在这些页面印数字价格。

question.en: Does the model number equal m³/h?
question.zh: 型号里的数字等于每小时立方米吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h. Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h. Read the output cell, not the numeral in the name.
answer.zh: 不等于。电动30印的是 12–15 m³/h。电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。读输送量格子，不要读名称里的数字。

question.en: Is every electric pump listed as 380 V?
question.zh: 每台电动泵都标明 380 V 吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D prints rated voltage 380 V. Electric 20, Electric 40 and Electric 80 do not print a voltage cell on the sheets used here. Send the site voltage and frequency in the inquiry.
answer.zh: 不是。B500S-83D 印有额定电压 380 V。电动20、电动40、电动80在此处使用的参数页上没有电压格子。请在询盘里写现场电压和频率。

answer.en: It is not on the catalogue. Hebei Pinjin Machinery confirms price only after an inquiry to the Xingtai contact page.
answer.zh: 不在目录上。河北品锦机械只在邢台询盘页确认价格。

question.en: Can I order a truck boom from this hub?
question.zh: 能从这个分类订车载臂架泵吗？

answer.en: No. The published electric lines are trailer and compact pipeline pumps. Truck-mounted placing booms are not catalogue products.
answer.zh: 不能。已公布的电动产品是拖式和紧凑型管道泵。车载臂架泵不是目录产品。
